materialProvenance.description: One spherical 250 micrometre grain with illustrative silica-rich material density 2650 kg/m^3. The 1 mm diameter, 0.5 mm deep verification vessel differs from the 30 mm experiment. Shape, size, density, loading and contact coefficients are declared example inputs, not measurements of a south-east Queensland beach sample.
materialProvenance.source: Numerical verification geometry only; no site-specific silica fraction, grain grading, friction or restitution measurements supplied.
